title: Rebuild the interiors freely, like a real university seen from above, informed by the 3D tour
details: (Owner, in chat, 2026-09-26) "FOR THE INSIDE, JUST GO AHEAD AND MAKE IT AS YOU SEE FIT, WE DON'T NEED A PROPER MAP, YOU CAN MAKE IT NICE AS PER HOW A UNIVERSITY CAMPUS LOOKS FROM THE TOP ...
